primary_target: All20 original expanded S04 arrays,4268 events. Exact shape, row order and every time/x/y/Q field; no reviewer counter totals assumed.
law_defaults: Use the unchanged public Law defaults, matching the original driver. The paired null changes only eta to0.
pilot_reuse: Full run reuses the exact reviewed two pilot pairs, then runs18 more pairs; no historical optimizer or score calls.
historical_comparison: Report exact float64 byte equality, fieldwise maximum absolute and ULP differences separately. First2 original JSONL and later S04 arrays differ by at most2ULP; do not require bit identity to both.
initial_controls: All original common counters and RNG stream0-6 counters/state hashes must match; stream7 is added, inactive and recorded. Full event ancestry/order matches initial JSONL exactly; floating fields use the same declared comparison.
coupling: For any positive run with zero thinning rejection, require exact float64 row bytes, canonical full event-record/ancestry bytes and RNG streams0-6 to equal its same-seed eta0 counterpart in the same runtime. This is a realized coupling check, not equality of probability laws.
observer: Wrap stream3.uniform to call the original exactly once, then read the pending immigrant time/location and evaluate the unchanged strict_stress and exp threshold. No draws or generator state changes. Reconcile observed decisions with actual counters; record minimum signed/absolute margin as numerical diagnostics only.
generator_limits: All original Limits defaults unchanged. Budget deadline_after applies the smaller operational per-simulation and phase remainder.
failure: Stop on any input, row, counter, RNG, ancestry or conditional-coupling mismatch; retain partial artifacts/counters and failed result. No tolerance change or replacement seed.
summary: Write deterministic summary.json only after the required full20-case roster passes. Runtime/environment belong in result.json. No summary may certify unexecuted/missing cases.
memory: Conductor observes process-tree memory against4GiB target and original event/candidate caps; this wrapper does not claim an OS memory boundary.
